Core Algorithm

1. Sector PCA Signal: C_reg(t) = (1-λ)C_sample + λC_prior (sector-aware regularization) signal(t) = V_target · V_us' · z_us(t) (cross-market factor projection) 2. Sector Cross-Correlation Signal: signal_j(t) = mean(r_us_sector(t)) (US sector avg → target stocks) 3. Regime Detection: IC(t) = SpearmanCorr(signal(t-1), return(t)) (daily information coefficient) Active(t) = Rolling_IC(t, M=40) > 0.03
